result.document_summary: A portion of the San Diego Municipal Code, Chapter 5 (Public Safety, Morals and Welfare), covering sidewalk work safety, vehicle vending, and weed, rubbish and waste abatement; it contains no rental housing rules.
result.notes: This part (116 of 364) is scraped from a gocodebook.com page whose URL refers to the anti-competitive automated rent price-fixing division (SDMC 98.1103), but the text provided is unrelated Chapter 5 material (public rights-of-way barriers, handbill distribution, vehicle vending, weed/rubbish/waste abatement and illegal dumping). None of it concerns rent increase limits, just-cause eviction, security deposits, screening fees, screening restrictions or algorithmic rent setting, so no rules are extracted. The algorithmic rent-setting text itself is not included in this part.
